messages:
jess: Quick heads-up — SDK PR #4124 (client-side auth change) depends on API change in backend PR #7890. Need to coordinate merge order and a short freeze for the console rollout.

alex: Thanks. API PR #7890 is ready and CI is green, just waiting on @sahil for one more approval. No schema changes, only endpoint param renamed.

sahil: Reviewing now, should finish in the next hour. Any compatibility shims in SDK?

jess: SDK includes a small shim: it accepts old param name and maps to new one for 2 deploy cycles. Code:```js
if (payload.oldKey) payload.newKey = payload.oldKey
```
We plan to remove shim in two weeks.

morgan: Console depends on the new API param too. Console PR #221 adds the UI toggle and needs the backend merged before we cut a canary.

ravi: Helm chart change required for runtime env var name (RELATED: helm PR #98). Runtime needs `AUTH_PARAM_NAME` renamed. That should be low-risk.

olivia: Suggest merge order: backend #7890 -> helm #98 -> SDK #4124 -> console #221. We can do a canary after SDK merge. Thoughts?

alex: That ordering looks good. We'll put an interlock label on the API PR and add step-by-step rollback notes.

jess: Can someone add a check-list in the API PR description for post-merge steps? I can add the SDK + console follow-ups.

sahil: Approved API PR with minor comment. @alex address the comment then feel free to merge during the 2pm-4pm merge window.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #7890 (unit/integration), e2e pending for console.

deploy-bot: Noted — tagging merges to avoid simultaneous runtime deploys. I'll schedule helm rollover 30m after backend merge.

morgan: I'll hold console canary until SDK publishes a release artifact. @jess can you ping when SDK release is cut?

jess: Will do. Plan: merge backend ~14:15, helm ~14:45, SDK 15:00 (release cut), console canary 15:20. I'll post updates in this thread and add PR links to the interlock checklist. :thumbsup:

alex: Merged API PR at 14:17, left rollback instructions in description.

ravi: Helm change applied and chart published at 14:49.

jess: SDK merged and released as v1.12.0 at 15:02 — tagging @morgan for canary.

morgan: Canary started at 15:22, telemetry looks normal so far. Will monitor for 1hr then promote.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Let's keep the postmortem light — just note the ordering and the shim removal timeline.

jess: Agreed. I'll open a short follow-up doc for the removal plan and schedule reminder for 2 weeks.

sahil: Looks good. Great coordination. :tada:
